text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r o-p-e-n-e-d t-h-e i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y l-e-d-g-e-r and l-o-g-g-e-d i-t-e-m 021 a-s c-l-o-s-e-d a-t t-h-e s-t-a-m-p, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a p-a-s-s-i-v-e m-a-r-k in t-h-e r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e f-i-n-a-l s-t-a-t-u-s r-e-c-o-n-c-i-l-i-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-i-l-e-d t-h-e o-u-t-l-i-n-e n-o-t-e-s u-n-d-e-r t-h-e i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-t-a-t-i-c d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t b-e-h-i-n-d, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n o-f a-u-t-h-o-r-s-h-i-p.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-l-o-s-e-d t-h-e c-o-u-n-t-s o-f t-h-e i-t-e-m-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a f-r-o-z-e-n a-c-c-o-u-n-t s-t-a-t-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t r-e-c-o-u-n-t.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-n-t-e-r-e-d t-h-e s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e i-n-t-o t-h-e s-t-a-m-p, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-i-m-e s-e-a-l in t-h-e l-o-g, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k o-f t-h-e c-l-o-s-i-n-g u-s-e-r.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-c-c-e-p-t-e-d t-h-e c-l-o-s-u-r-e a-s f-i-n-a-l, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-h-e i-t-e-m i-n a r-e-a-d-o-n-l-y s-t-a-t-u-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-e-v-i-e-w o-f t-h-e r-e-m-a-i-n-i-n-g q-u-e-s-t-i-o-n-s.
